July 24, 2026

Consistent conditions make for a solid day on Wausau-area rivers and streams

Anglers heading out to the Wisconsin River will find flows running at 1,120 cfs with a 5.7 mph southwesterly wind and steady barometric pressure keeping conditions consistent. Expect daylight from 5:35 a.m. to 8:34 p.m. Fishing conditions this week peak on Saturday, with a high near 86°F and dry skies on area rivers and lakes.
